title: Nazara swings to Rs 35 crore net profit as revenues rise 53%
summary: Nazara swings to Rs 35 crore net profit as revenues rise 53%
detailed: The company also swung to a net profit of Rs 35 crore compared to a loss of Rs 34 crore in the year-ago quarter, which was impacted by provisions against investments in real-money gaming companies following the August 2025 ban.
